_comment: Drukhari Faction Pack v1.2. Complete datasheet, detachment, enhancement, and army rules.

Leader.note: LEADER24.22 Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle. Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead.

Power from Pain.note: Pain Abilities All Drukhari units have a Pain ability, tagged with the word ‘Pain’. Pain abilities only apply to a unit while it is Empowered. If your Army Faction is DRUKHARI, you can Empower units from your army with Pain abilities by spending Pain tokens (see below).

Shadowfield.note: The 2+ invulnerable save is lost for the rest of the battle once the bearer loses wounds to an attack

Fights First.note: FIGHTS FIRST24.13 Those possessed of lightning-fast reactions may strike before the opponent can react. While every model in a unit has this ability, that unit is a Fights First unit. See the Resolve Fights First Combats step in the Fight phase (12.04).

act.label: Thrilling Spectacle: 3+ invulnerable save, 12 melee Attacks

Feel No Pain.note: FEEL NO PAIN24.12 The hardiest warriors refuse to be laid low, even by wounds that should by all rights prove lethal. This ability always takes the form Feel No Pain X+. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an X+, that wound is not lost.

act.label: Fleshcraft: spend 1 Pain token, return D3+1 (Master Regenesist: D3+3) Bodyguard models

Incubi Shrine Token.note: One token: one Hit roll becomes a 6 once per battle

Deep Strike.note: DEEP STRIKE24.09 There are many ways by which to deploy troops to the field of battle including tunnels, teleportation devices and other esoteric means of transportation. Each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.

Infiltrators.note: INFILTRATORS24.20 Many armies employ reconnaissance units who can sit concealed, waiting for the right moment to strike. During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.

Stealth.note: STEALTH24.33 The stealthiest warriors can evade the attentions, and the bullets, of their foes. If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

act.label: Fade Away: spend 1 Pain token, into Strategic Reserves
Spend 1 Pain token: melee Attacks 4 and [HAZARDOUS]

Deadly Demise.note: DEADLY DEMISE24.08 From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat. This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X.

Firing Deck.note: FIRING DECK24.14 Some transports have dedicated platforms or firing ports from which embarked passengers can lay down a withering hail of munitions. This ability always takes the form Firing Deck X.

Speed of the Kill.note: Disembarking Wyches must be set up wholly within 6" (the normal 3" rule is stricter in this app)

Visions of Butchery.note: Every embarked model counts (the card: WRACKS models)

act.label: Embark a DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit within 6"

Aerialists.note: The unit must have 6 or fewer models

act.label: Eviscerating Fly-by: 1 D6 per model, 4+ = 1 mortal wound

Cluster Caltrops.note: Eviscerating Fly-by re-rolls its failed dice (all of the unit's dice, not only the bearer's)

Void Mine.note: Only the selected model's unit is rolled for (the card: every enemy unit within D6" of it)

act.label: Normal move of up to 6" (no charge this turn)

Torture Device.note: One more Pain token each time this unit destroys an enemy unit

Pain Engine (Aura).note: Each Pain token spent to Empower a unit within 9": 5+ (+1 without a spirit vortex) gets it back

Precognisant.note: After deployment: redeploy up to three DRUKHARI units (set up again or into Strategic Reserves)

Scouts.note: SCOUTS24.31 Scouts form the vanguard of many armies. Unnoticed by the enemy, they range ahead of the main force. This ability always takes the form Scouts X".

Archon’s Will.note: Any objective counts (the card: the one selected at the start of the first battle round)

Lone Operative.note: LONE OPERATIVE24.24 Assassins and other covert agents are difficult to pinpoint in the storm of battle. Unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model i...

Battle Focus.note: Receive Battle Focus tokens each round based on battle size. Spend 1 token to trigger Agile Manoeuvres.

Disparate Paths.note: Can include Harlequins units in your army even without Asuryani keyword.

Flip Belt.note: The board is flat: vertical distance never counts

TRAVELLING PLAYERS.note: Army building: at most one of this model

PATH OF DAMNATION.note: Army building: cannot be your WARLORD

act.label: Embark a HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit within 6"

Rapid Embarkation.note: The unit must have 6 or fewer models (check when choosing)

act.label: Hero's Prowess: re-roll Hit rolls of 1

Prince of Corsairs.note: After deployment: redeploy up to three AELDARI units (set up again or into Strategic Reserves)

act.label: Raid and Run: move D3+3" (Fall Back if engaged)

Phantasmal Smoke.note: Within 6" of a DRUKHARI TRANSPORT (the card: wholly within)

Sadistic Fulcrum.note: Every DRUKHARI TRANSPORT within 6" while the bearer's unit is Empowered in the Shooting phase (the card: one of them)

Spiteful Raider.note: An enemy unit near an objective destroyed in the Fight phase: 1 more Pain token

Archraider.note: The DEDICATED TRANSPORT the bearer starts embarked in has Scouts 9"

act.label: Conductor of Torment: trade a Pain token for the wager

Dark Vitality.note: The bearer's unit is always Empowered

act.label: Eye of Spite: spend 1 Pain token for +2 Attacks and AP instead
Crucible of Malediction: enemy units within 12" take a Battle-shock test
Crucible of Malediction: spend 1 Pain token, tests at -1

Master Repugnomancer (Aura).note: Fear Incarnate reaches 9"; a friendly DRUKHARI unit within 9" failing a Battle-shock test or destroyed: 4+ for a Pain token

act.label: Leechbite Plate: spend 1 Pain token, the bearer regains all lost wounds
Overlord: a Battle-shocked unit within 12" is no longer Battle-shocked
